tools.name: udon-kit-mover-20261026.json
tools.description: Eight tested Udon kits a VRChat world is composed from instead of new scripts: doors to Doorspaces, teleport pads, hidden glass animals with a found count, toggles, a synced counter, timed respawn, audio zones and quests. Each is a pure C# core and an UdonSharp wrapper kept in step by parity tests.
requirements: The .NET 8 SDK and Node 20 for the tests; no NuGet packages.
Unity 2022.3 with the VRChat Worlds SDK (UdonSharp) in the world that uses the kits.
limitations: The tests run the cores and the wrappers against small stand-ins for the Unity and VRChat API; the real UdonSharp compile, scenes, ClientSim and networking are checked only on Astra's PC.
No world uses the kits yet, so there is no run record.
